name: Electronic Visitor Visa (e-Visa) for US, Canadian and Australian citizens
summary: Brazil brought back a visa requirement for US, Canadian and Australian citizens in 2025. Visits now need an e-Visa applied for online. Other details were not confirmed from an official page.

other: Official page was blocked to our reader. Stay length, validity, fee and date not confirmed. Check the MRE e-Visa page before publishing any numbers.

sources.label: Brazilian Consulate in New York: e-Visa page (could not be opened, blocked)

name: Digital Nomad Visa and Residence (VITEM XIV, CNIg RN 45/2021)
summary: Remote workers for a foreign employer can get a visa or in-country residence for up to one year. Renewable for an equal period. Working for a Brazilian employer does not qualify.

income.note: Foreign-source income. Alternative to the savings option.

savings.note: Bank funds, as an alternative to the income proof.

other: Must work remotely for a foreign employer or foreign clients.
Valid health insurance in Brazil is required for the consular visa application.
Criminal record certificate required.

documents: Health insurance valid in Brazil (visa route)
Declaration of ability to work remotely
Contract or proof of link with the foreign employer
steps: Choose the consular visa route or the in-country residence route
Gather the digital nomad proof and criminal record documents

sources.label: Ministry of Justice: list of CNIg normative resolutions

name: Retiree or Pension Holder Residence (CNIg RN 40/2019)
summary: Brazil has a visa and residence route based on retirement or a survivor pension (CNIg Resolution 40 of 2019). Income minimums and terms were not confirmed from an official page.

other: Resolution text was blocked to our reader. Income threshold, term and family rules not confirmed.

sources.label: Ministry of Justice: list of CNIg normative resolutions

name: Work Residence Authorization (employer-sponsored, CNIg RN 2/2017 and others)
summary: Immigrants who will work in Brazil apply for work residence through MigranteWeb, with a Federal Police step. Many specific categories exist (technical assistance, researchers, athletes, executives and more). Processing is up to 30 days for a properly filed case.

other: Category lists come from the Ministry of Justice resolutions index. Documents per category were not read.

processing: The official page estimates up to 30 days if the case is correctly filed, and up to 60 days if extra documents are requested.
steps: File the residence request with documents and the paid GRU
Register with the Federal Police and get the CRNM card

sources.label: Ministry of Justice: list of CNIg normative resolutions

name: Executive or Company Administrator Residence (CNIg RN 11/2017)
summary: Directors and managers of a Brazilian company can get residence based on foreign direct investment. The 2024 update lists R$ 600,000 per executive, or R$ 150,000 with job creation. Needs review since only the amending text was read.

investment.note: Or R$ 150,000 with job creation, per the amending text.

other: Job creation requirement mentioned in the amending text (ten new jobs in two years). Base resolution RN 11 was not read.

name: Individual Investor in a Brazilian Company (CNIg RN 13/2017)
summary: Foreign investors in a Brazilian company can get residence tied to the investment or business plan. The amount thresholds were not cleanly confirmed.

other: Amending text mentions a R$ 150,000 minimum for innovation or research entrepreneurs, but it contains a typo. Base resolution was blocked. Confirm amounts before use.

name: Real Estate Investor Residence (CNIg RN 36/2018)
summary: Buy at least R$ 1,000,000 of urban real estate with foreign funds and get 4 years of residence, then an indefinite term if the investment stays. The minimum can be up to 30% lower in the North and Northeast.

investment.note: Urban real estate, can be split across properties. Up to 30% lower in the North and Northeast.

other: Funds must be personal and of foreign origin.
Must stay in Brazil at least 14 days in every two-year period.
Financing allowed only for the part above the minimum.

stay.note: Can change to an indefinite term if the investment conditions are kept.

documents: Property registry certificate free of liens (built property)
Bank declaration confirming the international capital transfer
For property under construction: registered purchase promise contract, construction permit, incorporation memorandum

name: Study Residence Authorization
summary: Study is one of the listed grounds for residence authorization with the Federal Police. Requirements and term were not confirmed.

other: Only the existence of this ground was confirmed. Documents and term not read.

name: Family Reunification Residence
summary: Family reunification is a listed ground for residence authorization with the Federal Police. Who qualifies and the documents were not confirmed.

other: Only the existence of this ground was confirmed. Eligible relatives and documents not read.

name: Mercosur Residence Agreement
summary: Citizens of Argentina, Bolivia, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Paraguay, Peru and Uruguay can get residence in Brazil under the Mercosur agreement. Separate rules exist for Venezuela, Suriname and Guyana nationals at the border.

other: Venezuelan, Surinamese and Guyanese nationals have a separate border-country residence ground where Mercosur does not apply.

name: Humanitarian Residence and Protection
summary: Brazil offers residence on humanitarian grounds, for example for Haitians, victims of trafficking, children traveling alone and people affected by the Syrian conflict. Refugee claims go through the official process.

other: Groups listed by the Federal Police include Haitians, stateless persons, trafficking victims, unaccompanied minors and people affected by the Syrian conflict.

name: Indefinite-Term (Permanent) Residence
summary: Temporary residence can be converted to an indefinite term through the residence authorization service. Years needed depend on the original ground and were not confirmed.

other: Years required by ground not confirmed. Residence is lost after an absence of more than two years without justification (Decree 9,199, art. 135).
Residence card (CRNM) is valid for 9 years for indefinite-term holders, and with no expiry for people 60 or older.

name: Ordinary Naturalization
summary: Brazil has ordinary, definitive, special and provisional naturalization. Residence years, reduced periods and the Portuguese language rule could not be confirmed from an official page. Dual citizenship was also not confirmed.

other: Years of residence and reduced periods not confirmed.
Gov.br service pages for naturalization require login.

citizenship.note: Dual citizenship not confirmed from an official page.

name: Naturalization for Stateless Persons
summary: A recognized stateless person who chooses naturalization goes through a simplified process. They must show at least two years of residence in Brazil.

other: Must be recognized as stateless in Brazil.

name: Equal Rights for Portuguese Citizens
summary: Brazil has a gov.br service to get equal rights status for Portuguese citizens. Conditions were not read.

other: Only the service name was confirmed. Conditions not read.
